EXAM GUIDE / CHSL 2026

Know the pattern.
Find your rhythm.

Tier I: 25 questions per subject, 15 minutes each; 100 questions in 60 minutes. Marking: +2, −0.5.

Tier II Session I: Maths 30/30 min, Reasoning 30/30, English 40/40, GK 20/20, Computer 15/15. Marking: +3, −1. Computer is qualifying and scored separately.

Eligible compensatory-time settings are available before a mock. Completed subjects lock automatically.

Read the official SSC CHSL 2026 notice ↗

Your typing milestone.

LDC/JSA: English 35 WPM, Hindi 30 WPM; 10 minutes. DEO skill practice: 15 minutes. This studio supplies English passages. Check the notice for post-specific skill standards and extra-time eligibility.

Typing scores are local practice estimates. Correct KDPH = aligned correct characters × 3,600 ÷ elapsed seconds; WPM = KDPH ÷ 300.

Mocks use original practice exercises and static facts, not official papers. Results do not determine SSC qualification.

02 / YOUR SUBJECT, YOUR PACE

Work on your next strength.

Made for practice. Independently made, with no SSC affiliation. The bank contains generated numerical and grammar variants, authored exercises and sourced static facts. Distinct questions can share a concept or template. It is not a collection of official papers or a fully reviewed replacement for the syllabus. Current affairs, diagrams and complete Tier II difficulty coverage are not included. English interface and questions.
Question sources & downloads

Numerical, reasoning, English and computer exercises were created for this studio. Static GK uses a source snapshot from mledoze/countries (ODbL), Periodic-Table-JSON (CC BY-SA 3.0) and Wikidata (CC0), with authored Indian/static GK additions. Factual snapshots may change. Each sourced item retains its source in the downloadable bank. The country-derived database is offered under ODbL 1.0; periodic-table material and its adaptations retain CC BY-SA 3.0 attribution and terms. These sources and changes are recorded in the download.

BEFORE YOU BEGIN

Your test at a glance.

A clear desk. A steady mind.

  1. Answer one option per question. Save & next, clear an answer or mark it for review.
  2. Move freely within the active subject. A completed subject locks; the next opens automatically when its timer expires. Unused time is not transferred.
  3. The timer continues in the background and after refresh. Use Quit & view result if you need to leave.
  4. Marked answers are scored when selected. Unanswered questions score zero. Submit ends the entire attempt.
  5. Practice results do not determine SSC eligibility or qualification. Numerical decimal answers are rounded to three decimal places unless stated otherwise.
